_note: Weekly standings per position from Sport.fun Live Scores (pro.football.fun), 2026 regular season, completed weeks only. Each row is [tokenIdSuffix, rank|null, points, earnedTP]. rank null means listed but did not play. earnedTP is Sport.fun reward > 0, which is paid to exactly the top 3 at QB/TE and top 5 at RB/WR. Source endpoints (signed-in session required): GET /api/nfl/v3/tournaments/ for the weekly tournaments (seasonYear 2026, status Completed); GET /api/nfl/v3/tournaments/<id>/standings/<POS>?limit=200 for ranking, score, reward; GET /api/nfl/v3/players/?limit=200 to map playerId to oPlayerId (the ERC-1155 token id). Rebuild with: node scripts/build-tournament-matrix-2026.mjs --write
_tpNote: TP won per player per week, from GET /api/nfl/v3/tournaments/players/<playerId>/rewards (datasets[0].data: x = settlement time, y = TP, rank). This is the series behind the TP chart on each player page, and differs from the standings reward field. Weeks are matched by settlement date (the Monday after each week). The endpoint returns the full history, so one pass over all players refreshes every week. Ranks there use shared ranks for ties (1,1,2...), so the matrix keeps the standings ranks; TP is paid to exactly the players the standings flag.
_activeNote: Active shares per player (globalShares.active from GET /api/nfl/v3/players/?limit=200). TP is split only among active shares, so TP per $100 spent = TP won x 100 / (current share price x active shares). Snapshot, refreshed with each weekly capture.
